title: Archipelia ready: a world found by topic is Not reviewed and asks first
covers: topic archipelia-world, Not reviewed note, trust dialog
context: Any public GitHub repository with the topic archipelia-world and a valid release can show under Archipelia ready. Archipelia has not reviewed these, so the card says so, they rank below the Verified worlds, and Add asks first because the world runs Python code when a game is generated.
changed: packages/catalog ready: one GitHub search, a disk cache of 6 hours, the spoofing guard, hidden forks, archived and unreleased repos
views/GameStore: trustConsent dialog, DISCOVERED_LABEL, the note Not reviewed by Archipelia

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: network
setup.text: Needed. One GitHub search lists the repositories. GitHub allows few searches per minute, and a wait shows as a sentence with a time. That is not a failure.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: world
setup.text: At least one repository with the topic archipelia-world must exist and have a stable release. If the tab shows only Verified worlds, mark this test blocked and say so.

steps: Open Library, Games, tab Archipelia ready. Verified worlds list first. Look for a card with no Verified badge and the note Not reviewed by Archipelia.
Press the title of that card. The dialog kind line reads Archipelia ready world, found by its topic and not reviewed by Archipelia.

Close the dialog and press A dialog titled Add and the world name opens It says Archipelia has not reviewed this world and that it runs Its facts list Repository, Published by and Stars The buttons are Add this world and Cancel.
Press Cancel. Nothing is installed and the card is unchanged.
Press Add again and then Add this world. The card shows Adding..., then Installed, and a toast reads Installed.

Press Refresh index. It spins, then stops. If GitHub asks Archipelia to wait, a sentence with a time shows and the list stays. Search the owner name of that repository in Search worlds: the card is found.
Remove the world with Remove and Delete so it is not left behind.
pass: A world found by topic shows under Archipelia ready, below the Verified ones, with the note Not reviewed by Archipelia and no Verified badge.
Add asks first with the repository, the publisher and the stars. Cancel installs nothing.
Add this world installs it and the card moves to Installed.
fail: A topic world has a Verified badge, or Add installs it with no question.
The dialog misses the repository or the publisher, or Cancel still installs.
Refresh index shows a red code or stack instead of a sentence.
notes: A topic world that claims the module of a Verified or Built-in world is hidden on purpose. That is not a failure.
Forks, archived repositories and repositories with no stable release or no archipelia.json are hidden on purpose.
The answer is remembered per repository. If the repository moves to another owner, Archipelia asks again.
